title: Replace AI generation with template selection in bulk upload and add bulk delete capability to product management

requirements.summary: Remove the 'Generate AI Description' button from BulkProductUpload component, eliminating AI description generation functionality from the bulk upload flow
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Generate AI Description' button is no longer visible in the bulk upload interface
No AI description generation logic is triggered during bulk upload
The description field remains editable but uses only template-based pre-population

file_operations.description: Remove the 'Generate AI Description' button and all associated AI generation logic including state variables, event handlers, and mutation hooks. Keep the description field editable and ensure the template selector dropdown remains functional.

requirements.summary: Update BulkProductUpload to automatically populate description fields using the selected template from the dropdown without requiring additional button clicks
acceptanceCriteria: When a template is selected from the dropdown, all product description fields are immediately populated with the template content
The description field remains manually editable after template population
Template selection works seamlessly with the existing auto-copy functionality when enabled

file_operations.description: Modify the template selection handler to immediately populate all product description fields when a template is chosen from the dropdown. Ensure this works with the existing auto-copy functionality by updating the description fields in the products state array. The descriptions should remain editable after population.

requirements.summary: Add checkbox selection controls to ProductManagementTable allowing admin to select multiple products for bulk operations
acceptanceCriteria: Each product row displays a checkbox in the first column
A 'select all' checkbox in the table header allows selecting/deselecting all products at once
Selected rows are visually distinguished (e.g., highlighted background)
The selection state persists across inline edits but clears after bulk delete operation

file_operations.description: Add a new column at the beginning of the table with checkboxes for each product row. Add a 'select all' checkbox in the table header. Implement selection state management using useState to track selected product IDs. Apply visual highlighting (e.g., bg-blue-50) to selected rows. Ensure selection state persists during inline edits but provide a method to clear selections after delete operations.

requirements.summary: Add 'Delete Selected' button to ProductManagementTable that shows confirmation dialog before deleting multiple products
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Delete Selected' button is disabled when no products are selected
The button shows the count of selected products (e.g., 'Delete Selected (3)')
Clicking the button displays a confirmation dialog asking 'Are you sure you want to delete X products?'
After confirmation, all selected products are deleted via backend calls
A success toast notification displays the number of products deleted
The table refreshes to remove deleted products and clears all selections

file_operations.description: Add a 'Delete Selected' button above or below the table that is disabled when no products are selected. Display the count of selected products in the button label. Implement a confirmation dialog using shadcn/ui Dialog or AlertDialog component that shows 'Are you sure you want to delete X products?' before proceeding. Wire the button to use the useBulkDeleteProducts mutation hook. Display a success toast showing the number of deleted products. Clear selection state and refresh the products query after successful deletion.

requirements.summary: Create useBulkDeleteProducts React Query mutation hook that deletes multiple products by calling deleteProduct for each ID with proper error handling and cache invalidation
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation hook accepts an array of product ID strings
All delete operations are executed and their results aggregated
On success, the products query cache is invalidated to refresh the product list
Errors during bulk delete are captured and reported to the user
The hook returns loading state and error information for UI feedback

file_operations.description: Add a new useBulkDeleteProducts mutation hook that accepts an array of product IDs (bigint[]). Use Promise.allSettled or sequential calls to execute actor.deleteProduct for each ID. Aggregate results to track successes and failures. On success, invalidate the 'products' query key to refresh the product list. Return loading state, error information, and success/failure counts for UI feedback. Handle partial failures gracefully by reporting which products failed to delete.
